speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you prefer living in a house or in an apartment?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Honestly, I don't really know the difference between a house and an apartment, because I come from a developing city — we don't have that distinction there. I always just called it a house. So I guess a house is maybe bigger than an apartment, or maybe cheaper? Based on that, I'd say I prefer living in a house.
